# Agent Architectures

[Home](../../README.md) · [All categories](../README.md) · [简体中文](agent-architectures_cn.md)

Body Motion and Whole-Body Control Models → Agent Architectures

Agent architectures for whole-body task planning and skill coordination across locomotion, stance adjustment, active perception and manipulation. Record high-level plans, intermediate skill grounding, feedback and the input/output interfaces of separate low-level policies. Whole-body task coordination does not establish unified joint-level motion planning or a single whole-body action policy; hand hardware alone does not determine primary placement.

| [AM.WBC.AGENT.1] <a id="am-wbc-agent-1"></a> | **Being-0｜Agent whole-body task planning · Connector skill grounding · Navigation–manipulation coordination**<br>[Being-0: A Humanoid Robotic Agent with Vision-Language Models and Modular Skills](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2503.12533v2)<br>Haoqi Yuan, Yu Bai, Yuhui Fu, Bohan Zhou, Yicheng Feng, Xinrun Xu, Yi Zhan, Börje F. Karlsson, Zongqing Lu<br>**Tags:** `agent-architecture` `humanoid` `whole-body-task-planning` `task-planning` `navigation-manipulation-coordination` `embodied-connector` `skill-grounding` `skill-library` `stance-adjustment` `active-vision` `act` `imitation-learning` [reinforcement-learning](../topics/reinforcement-learning.md) `locomotion-policy` `dexterous` `inspire-hand` `real-world` | Being-0 combines a cloud task planner with an onboard VLM Connector to decompose long-horizon tasks and ground them into navigation, stance-adjustment and manipulation skills, coordinating RL locomotion and ACT bimanual manipulation policies for continuous humanoid task execution.<br>**Evaluation scope:** The contribution is whole-body task planning and skill coordination. Cloud GPT-4o uses tasks, images and execution history to assess progress and select subtasks; the onboard Connector grounds language plans in current images, detects targets and combines binocular depth with composite navigation routines to adjust stance, e.g. reaching the table before grasping a cup. The VideoLLaMA2-based Connector is supervised-finetuned on general visual grounding and indoor visual-understanding/skill-prediction data. A simulation-trained RL locomotion policy reads velocity commands and proprioception and outputs lower-body joint targets at 50 Hz. Separate teleoperation-trained ACT skills take binocular images and upper-body/head joint state and output arm, hand and head action chunks (30 training steps, 10 deployment steps). Feedback revises plans, skill calls and stance; no online weight updates or unified whole-body joint policy are introduced. Unitree H1-2 with two Inspire hands and an active ZED-mini camera evaluates five long tasks in a 20-by-20-metre office. The reported 84.4% averages substep completion, not fully successful task rollouts: fetching scores 90% from 5/5 navigation and 4/5 grasping. As of verification, the official repository still promises code release; complete implementation, training-data and weight downloads were not found. | arXiv v2 / 2025 | [Paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2503.12533v2) · [Project](https://beingbeyond.github.io/Being-0/) · [Code](https://github.com/BeingBeyond/Being-0) | Initial reading<br>2026-10-27 |
